scenario.name: Google Cloud Mandiant IR & MITRE DFIR — GCP Cloud Audit ServiceAccountKey Creation & Impersonation Chain Forensics
scenario.overview: Imagine a cloud research campus where an intruder uses a compromised junior badge to borrow the temporary voice of a senior data-warehouse account, uses that borrowed authority to stamp a permanent offline spare key at the badge kiosk, and then steps directly into the analytics warehouse to export entire confidential tables out to an external bucket. In this scenario (T1078.004, Google Cloud Mandiant IR & MITRE DFIR, GCP Cloud Audit ServiceAccountKey Creation & Impersonation Chain Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: service Account Impersonation, then persistent User-Managed JSON Key Creation, then bigQuery Table Export. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Service Account Impersonation, then Persistent User-Managed JSON Key Creation, then BigQuery Table Export, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates process, authentication, and network telemetry for T1078.004 across the documented kill chain.

stages.title: Stage 2: Persistent User-Managed JSON Key Creation (google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccountKey)
stages.subtitle: Persistence (T1098.001 - Additional Cloud Credentials: CreateServiceAccountKey)

stages.title: Stage 3: BigQuery Table Export & Query Exfiltration Attribution (JobInserted & totalBilledBytes)
stages.subtitle: Exfiltration (T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage: BigQuery JobInserted)
stages.description: Signing straight into the analytics warehouse with the newly printed key, the intruder submits bulk extraction jobs that sweep entire customer datasets out of the vault while the warehouse metering log records every query and exact gigabyte moved. Using the exported JSON key from 198.51.100.84, the actor queries BigQuery dataset corp_prod.customer_records. Next, the follow-up artifact metadata.jobChange.job.jobStats.queryStats.totalBilledBytes: "2147483648" runs (which executes the technical command / telemetry directive , metadata.jobChange.job.jobStats.queryStats.totalBilledBytes: "2147483648" via System / Runti so that advances the scenario kill-chain under MITRE T1530 during "BigQuery Table Export & Query Exfiltration Attribution , JobInserted & totalBilledBytes" , Using the exported JSON key from 198 while generating verifiable host or network telemetry for DFIR attribution).
